points.location_plain: Find the hollow just below the outer end of your collarbone, where the arm meets the chest. Zhongfu is one thumb-width below that hollow, level with the gap under your first rib.
points.location_anatomical: On the upper chest, 6 cun lateral to the midline, level with the first intercostal space, in the hollow below the outer end of the collarbone.

traditional.term: Heat Excess Arising From The Middle Warmer

points.location_plain: Press into the soft hollow directly below the outer end of your collarbone, near the front of the shoulder. That hollow is Yunmen.
points.location_anatomical: On the upper chest, in the hollow below the outer end of the clavicle, 6 cun lateral to the midline.

points.location_plain: On the inner-front of your upper arm, four finger-widths below the front crease of the armpit, on the outer edge of the biceps.
points.location_anatomical: On the upper arm, 3 cun below the front axillary fold, on the outer edge of the biceps muscle.

traditional.term: Medial Aspect Of Upper Arm Pain

points.location_plain: One thumb-width below LU3 on the outer edge of the biceps, roughly five finger-widths below the front of the armpit.
points.location_anatomical: On the upper arm, 4 cun below the front axillary fold, on the outer edge of the biceps, 1 cun below LU3.

traditional.term: Medial Aspect Of Upper Arm Pain

points.location_plain: Bend your elbow slightly and feel the firm tendon in the middle of the crease. Chize is in the hollow just to the thumb side of that tendon.
points.location_anatomical: In the elbow crease, in the hollow on the thumb side of the biceps tendon.

points.location_plain: On the thumb side of your inner forearm, a little above the midpoint between the elbow crease and the wrist crease (about 7 thumb-widths above the wrist). Press for a tender spot.
points.location_anatomical: On the forearm, 7 cun above the wrist crease, on the line between LU5 and LU9.

points.location_plain: Interlock the webs of your thumbs; where the tip of the index finger lands on the other wrist, just above the bony bump on the thumb side, is Lieque, in a small groove.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease, in the groove above the styloid process of the radius.

traditional.plain: poor blood flow to the brain

points.location_plain: One thumb-width above the wrist crease on the thumb side, right next to where you feel your pulse.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the inner wrist, 1 cun above the wrist crease, between the radial artery and the radius bone.

points.location_plain: On the inner wrist crease, on the thumb side, where you feel your pulse. Taiyuan is in the hollow just to the thumb side of the pulse.
points.location_anatomical: At the wrist crease on the thumb side, in the hollow on the outer side of the radial artery.

points.location_plain: Find the fleshy mound at the base of your thumb. Yuji is in the middle of that mound, on its edge where the darker palm skin meets the lighter skin of the back of the hand.
points.location_anatomical: On the palm side of the hand, at the midpoint of the first metacarpal bone, at the border between the red and white skin.

points.location_plain: At the corner of the thumbnail on the side away from the fingers, about 2 mm from the nail.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail on the outer (radial) side.

points.location_plain: At the corner of the index fingernail on the thumb side, about 2 mm from the nail.
points.location_anatomical: On the index finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail on the thumb side.

points.location_plain: Make a loose fist. On the thumb side of the index finger, just in front of the big knuckle, in the hollow where the skin colour changes.
points.location_anatomical: On the index finger, in the hollow on the thumb side just below the knuckle at the base of the finger, at the border of red and white skin.

points.location_plain: Make a loose fist. On the thumb side of the index finger, just behind the big knuckle (toward the wrist), in the hollow.
points.location_anatomical: On the back of the hand, on the thumb side of the index finger, in the hollow just behind the knuckle at the base of the finger.

traditional.plain: swelling on the back of the hand

points.location_plain: Squeeze your thumb and index finger together; Hegu is at the highest point of the muscle bulge in the web between them. Press toward the bone of the index finger for a strong ache. Avoid in pregnancy.
points.location_anatomical: On the back of the hand, between the first and second metacarpal bones, at the midpoint of the second metacarpal on the thumb side.

points.location_plain: Stretch your thumb out and back; a small triangular hollow appears at the base of the thumb on the wrist. Yangxi is in that hollow.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the wrist, in the hollow between the two tendons of the thumb (the anatomical snuffbox).

points.location_plain: Four finger-widths above the wrist on the thumb side of the back of the forearm, along the line running to the outer elbow.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 3 cun above the wrist crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.

points.location_plain: Halfway between the wrist and the elbow on the thumb-side edge of the back of the forearm, then a little toward the wrist (5 thumb-widths above the wrist).
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 5 cun above the wrist crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.

points.location_plain: On the thumb-side edge of the forearm, four thumb-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 4 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.

points.location_plain: Four finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, on the thumb-side edge of the forearm.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 3 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.

points.location_plain: Bend your elbow. Three finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, on the fleshy muscle of the forearm. Usually quite tender.
points.location_anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 2 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.

points.location_plain: Bend your elbow fully. Quchi is at the outer end of the elbow crease, in the hollow between the crease and the bony point of the elbow.
points.location_anatomical: At the outer end of the elbow crease, midway between the biceps tendon and the bony knob of the outer elbow.

points.location_plain: One thumb-width above the outer end of the elbow crease, on the edge of the bone of the upper arm.
points.location_anatomical: On the outer upper arm, 1 cun above LI11, on the ridge of bone above the elbow.

points.location_plain: Four finger-widths above the outer end of the elbow crease, on the outer side of the upper arm.
points.location_anatomical: On the outer upper arm, 3 cun above LI11, on the line from LI11 to LI15.

points.location_plain: On the outer upper arm, where the lower tip of the shoulder muscle (deltoid) ends, about three-quarters of the way up from the elbow toward the shoulder (7 thumb-widths above the outer elbow crease).
points.location_anatomical: On the outer upper arm, at the insertion of the deltoid muscle, 7 cun above LI11.

points.location_plain: Raise your arm out to the side: two hollows appear at the tip of the shoulder. Jianyu is the front one.
points.location_anatomical: On the shoulder, in the front hollow that appears below the tip of the shoulder bone when the arm is raised sideways.

points.location_plain: On top of the shoulder, in the dip just inside the outer end of the collarbone, between the collarbone and the ridge of the shoulder blade.
points.location_anatomical: On the shoulder, in the hollow between the outer end of the collarbone and the spine of the shoulder blade.

points.location_plain: On the side of the neck, one thumb-width below LI18, behind the big neck muscle, level with the lower edge of the Adam's apple.
points.location_anatomical: On the side of the neck, 1 cun below LI18, on the rear edge of the sternocleidomastoid muscle.

points.location_plain: Turn your head slightly; the big neck muscle stands out. Futu is level with the Adam's apple, in the middle of that muscle.
points.location_anatomical: On the side of the neck, level with the tip of the Adam's apple, between the two heads of the sternocleidomastoid muscle.

points.location_plain: On the upper lip, straight below the outer edge of your nostril, halfway between nose and lip.
points.location_anatomical: On the upper lip, directly below the outer edge of the nostril, level with the midpoint of the philtrum.

points.location_plain: In the crease that runs from the nose to the corner of the mouth, right beside the widest part of the nostril.
points.location_anatomical: In the groove beside the nose, level with the midpoint of the outer edge of the nostril.

points.location_plain: Look straight ahead. Just below the lower eyelid, on the rim of the eye socket, directly under the pupil. Press very gently on the bone.
points.location_anatomical: On the face, between the eyeball and the lower rim of the eye socket, directly below the pupil.

points.location_plain: Directly below the pupil, about one thumb-width below the lower eyelid, in a small hollow in the cheekbone.
points.location_anatomical: On the face, in the hollow of the infraorbital foramen, directly below the pupil.

points.location_plain: Directly below the pupil, level with the bottom of the nose, on the cheek.
points.location_anatomical: On the face, directly below the pupil, level with the lower edge of the nostril.

points.location_plain: Just beside the corner of the mouth, about half a thumb-width out.
points.location_anatomical: On the face, 0.4 cun lateral to the corner of the mouth.

points.location_plain: Clench your teeth to feel the jaw muscle bulge. Daying is in the notch just in front of that muscle, on the edge of the jawbone, where a pulse can be felt.
points.location_anatomical: On the lower jaw, in front of the angle of the jaw, in the groove on the front edge of the masseter muscle, over the facial artery.

points.location_plain: Clench your teeth; the jaw muscle bulges. Jiache is at the high point of that bulge, about one finger-width up and forward from the angle of the jaw.
points.location_anatomical: On the cheek, one finger-width above and in front of the angle of the jaw, at the prominence of the masseter muscle when the teeth are clenched.

points.location_plain: Close your mouth. Just in front of the ear, below the cheekbone arch, is a hollow that disappears when you open your mouth. That hollow is Xiaguan.
points.location_anatomical: On the face, in the hollow below the zygomatic arch, in front of the condyle of the jaw.

points.location_plain: At the corner of the forehead where the hairline turns down toward the temple, half a thumb-width inside the hairline.
points.location_anatomical: On the head, 0.5 cun above the corner of the forehead hairline, 4.5 cun lateral to the midline.

points.safety_note: Over the carotid artery: do not press firmly.
points.location_plain: Beside the Adam's apple, on the front edge of the big neck muscle, where you feel the pulse of the carotid artery. Do not press firmly.
points.location_anatomical: On the neck, level with the tip of the Adam's apple, on the front edge of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, over the carotid artery.

points.location_plain: On the front edge of the big neck muscle, halfway between the Adam's apple level and the collarbone.
points.location_anatomical: On the neck, on the front edge of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, midway between ST9 and ST11.

points.location_plain: Just above the collarbone near its inner end, in the small dip between the two bands of the big neck muscle.
points.location_anatomical: On the neck, on the upper edge of the inner end of the clavicle, between the two heads of the sternocleidomastoid muscle.

points.location_plain: In the middle of the deep hollow above the collarbone, on a line straight down from the nipple (men) or mid-collarbone. Press gently.
points.location_anatomical: On the neck, in the centre of the hollow above the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the midline.

points.location_plain: Just below the collarbone, on the line straight down from its middle (about four thumb-widths from the centre of the chest).
points.location_anatomical: On the chest, in the hollow below the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the midline.

points.location_plain: Sit with your thigh flexed; a hollow appears on the front-outer thigh just below the bony point of the hip. Biguan is in that hollow, level with the pubic bone.
points.location_anatomical: On the front of the thigh, in the hollow between the sartorius and tensor fasciae latae, on the line from the hip bone to the outer edge of the kneecap, level with the crease below the buttock.

points.location_plain: On the front-outer thigh, about a hand-length (6 thumb-widths) above the outer top corner of the kneecap. The muscle bulges here when you tense the thigh.

points.location_plain: Four finger-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap, on the front-outer thigh.
points.location_anatomical: On the front of the thigh, 3 cun above the upper outer corner of the kneecap, on the line to the hip bone.

points.location_plain: Three finger-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap, in a hollow on the outer side of the thigh muscle. Often tender.

points.location_plain: Bend your knee. Just below the kneecap, two dimples appear either side of the thick tendon. Dubi is the outer dimple.

traditional.plain: leg weakness and swelling (vitamin B1 deficiency)
